description:
Welcome! If you’re a homeowner with an electrical problem, you’re in the right place.

I believe homeowners don't need to become electricians to understand what's happening inside their homes. With the right information, you can often identify the symptoms, narrow down the possible causes, and give your electrician valuable information about the problem.

You'll also learn the difference between a simple problem you may be able to safely identify yourself and an electrical issue that requires a licensed electrician.

No electrical jargon. No unnecessary complexity. Just practical information from 30+ years in the electrical trade.

Subscribe and learn how to understand your home's electrical system and troubleshoot electrical problems safely.

My goal is simple: Help homeowners become informed, safer, and more confident when dealing with electrical problems—before they pick up the phone and call an electrician.
